contents.title: Quiz Diagnostic 1ere Anglais - Serie 41
contents.subject: Anglais
contents.description: Diagnostic Anglais 1ere : Les marqueurs de discours et la cohésion textuelle

questions.question: Choose the best discourse marker: 'The project was expensive. ___, it was completed on time.'
'Furthermore' and 'However' can both be used to introduce an additional idea that supports the previous argument.
Relie les deux phrases avec le bon marqueur de discours (cause-effet) : 'The factory was polluting the river. / The local government decided to close it.'
Which sentence correctly uses 'despite'?
choices: Despite the weather was terrible, we enjoyed the trip.
Despite of the terrible weather, we enjoyed the trip.
Despite the terrible weather, we enjoyed the trip.
Despite that the weather was terrible, we enjoyed the trip.

questions.question: Using the same word repeatedly in a text is a sign of good writing because it ensures clarity.
Identifie le marqueur de discours manquant et justifie ton choix : 'Deforestation destroys ecosystems. ___, it contributes to climate change by releasing stored carbon.'
Which sentence demonstrates good text cohesion through pronoun reference?
choices: Einstein was a genius. Einstein changed physics. Einstein's theories are still used today.
Einstein was a genius. He changed physics. His theories are still used today.
Einstein was a genius. The man changed physics. The genius's theories are still used today.
Einstein was a genius. Einstein he changed physics. His theories are still used today.

questions.question: The discourse marker 'in conclusion' is used to introduce the final paragraph of an essay and signal that the writer is summarising their main points.

exercisenotion.description: Addition : Furthermore, Moreover, In addition, Besides, Also, What is more, Not only... but also. Illustration/exemple : For example, For instance, Such as, In particular, Notably, To illustrate, As shown by. Ces marqueurs enrichissent un argument en ajoutant des informations ou des exemples concrets.

exercisenotion.notion: Marqueurs de contraste, concession et cause-effet
exercisenotion.description: Contraste : However, Nevertheless, On the other hand, In contrast, Yet, Whereas, While, Despite, Although. Concession : Admittedly, Even though, It is true that. Cause-effet : Therefore, Thus, Hence, As a result, Consequently, This leads to, Due to, Because of. Ces connecteurs structurent la logique de l'argumentation.

La cohésion textuelle assure la fluidité du texte. Outils principaux : pronoms de référence (it, they, this, these), synonymes et paraphrases pour éviter les répétitions, substitution lexicale (the phenomenon → it), ellipses. Un texte cohésif est facile à suivre car les liens entre phrases et paragraphes sont clairs.
